decision.causal_statement_admitted: Under the frozen M681 sample-0/d0 producer and recorded runtime, cudnn_allow_tf32=false is the unique effective recorded control that changes the M511-compatible branch into the M660-r4 branch.

source_audit.conclusion: The early control snapshot remains valid through forward under the frozen inference source graph.

p2_findings.title: Per-mode results do not include a complete independently sealed launch/runtime receipt
p2_findings.impact: Each JSON records the decisive PyTorch controls, CUBLAS setting, runtime versions/device name, model/input identities and output hash, but not exact argv, complete environment, driver/GPU UUID, timestamp, or repetition count.
p2_findings.boundary: Do not broaden the claim beyond the frozen sample-0/d0 diagnostic or use it to authorize a one-shot/performance result.
p2_findings.future_repair: Future causal DSEs should seal exact argv, complete environment and post-build/pre-forward control snapshots for every mode.
